description: Full frozen proxy for soul-7 admission. AI half from legal generator datasets (DRAGON SDXL/Flux.1/PixArt-α + OpenFake test). No hashed subset. Never train on these hashes.
formula: attempted N; skip-rate=skips/N; BA=(TPR+TNR)/2 on scored only; pass iff BA>=0.750 and skip-rate<=0.10
